text:
elaine: Sharing a prototype for onboarding-first-time users to API keys. Main goals: clarity, low-risk defaults, and clear recovery paths. Figma: https://figma.com/rdw/onboard-key-v2

mike: Love the walkthrough steps. One thing: the CTA copy 'Create key' feels risky. Maybe 'Create test key' for the first-run to signal limited scope?

sophie: We also need a visible fallback path: 'Lost secret? Generate new key' right next to the helper text so users don't try to reuse revealed tokens.

raj: From infra perspective, add a staging flag for new keys created via onboarding. Staged keys have an attribute so UI can show "safe to test" badge and be excluded from org-wide audits until promoted.

samira: Accessibility: if we add badges like "Safe to test", ensure they're in the accessible name: e.g., `Badge: Safe to test. Not production.` Also ensure the helper tooltip is tabbable.

ben: Copy suggestion for empty state: "No API keys yet — create a test key to try the API, or set org-wide defaults for production keys." Keep it 1-2 lines.

elaine: UX trade: showing both full help card and compact CTA at once is noisy. Proposal: show full help for orgs <7 days old or <5 API calls; otherwise show compact. Thoughts?

mike: +1 for detection, but add an override toggle for admins so they can force expanded help for new hires.

samira: Keyboard flow: ensure the 'reveal secret' action is reachable by keyboard and triggers an aria-live announcement: "Secret revealed. Copy now." Use short assertive message.

sophie: For rotate flow in onboarding, offer 'Create & swap' as default instead of immediate invalidate. Show a short timeline graphic: Stage -> Update callers -> Swap -> Revoke old. Visuals help non-engineers.

raj: We'll expose an API endpoint for 'stage-and-swap' that returns a swap token and the UI can poll status. Works well with CSV of callers UI.

ben: Contrast/legibility nit: the muted helper text under keys is 12px/400 on a 0.6 gray. Fails AA at small sizes. Recommend 0.75 gray or 13px/500.

elaine: Good catch. Also thinking of a small inline checklist in the create modal: permissions chosen, notify team, rotate schedule. Each item has an inline help link. Keeps users thinking about safety.

samira: Make checklist items keyboard togglable and ensure they persist as local prefs so repeat creators see defaults. Also aria-describedby for each checklist explanation.

deploy-bot: Visual regression job queued for branch `feat/onboard-keys-v2` — 7 snapshots. Will report failures to #eng-releases.

elaine: Thanks team — I'll update the mock to include staged-flag badges, explicit "test key" wording, the checklist, and accessibility labels. Will re-upload and tag UX thread.
